serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: You look better, Mr. Landlord. Back when I told you the truth about your daughter I thought that you would never recover.
Landlord: It still hurts, but I’m trying to stay positive. 
Landlord: After all, we are going to the Paradisium Island! 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Landlord: With a little bit of luck I might make a new daughter, Buahahahaha!
You: That was too far…
Landlord: Come on, that was obviously a joke. 
You: It’s really hard to tell with you sometimes, Mister.
Bot: Right…
Landlord: A-Anyway! Without any further ado! Let’s go to the airport!
